sentences.ar: גנב נכנס לבית של ג'וחא בלילה.
sentences.en: A thief came into Juha's house at night.
He started searching in the dark.
Juha woke up and started searching with him.

sentences.ar: הגנב פחד ואמר: מה אתה עושה?
sentences.en: The thief was frightened and said: what are you doing?
He said: I am helping you.
In the day I find nothing.
Maybe at night something will turn up.
